As we look ahead to the rest of the week, we can expect a mix of sunshine and increasing rain chances, with temperatures sticking to their typical late spring pattern.

As we head into the week, we can expect the temperatures to stay warm, with highs reaching into the mid-30s. The geography of Abuja plays a big role in our weather, with the city's location in the heart of Nigeria meaning that we're subject to a mix of different weather patterns. The Harmattan winds that blow in from the north during the dry season have given way to the warmer, more humid air from the south, and this will continue to be the case for the rest of the week. As we look ahead, we can expect the wind patterns to shift a bit, with a bit more of a southerly component developing by the middle of the week.
